== Publication history ==
* '''Original''' ([[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]). The official Set 0 slip says “up to 15 cards” and “may play a Defensive Shield”.<ref>[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 11. Official text as of 1 August 2016, captured 6 August 2016. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''Errata''' ([[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Errata)]]). The 2017 slip says “any number of Defensive Shields” and “may play a card”.<ref>[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 9. Captured 4 July 2017. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The July 2018 full-card image repeats that wording and shows the E mark.<ref>Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/angerfearaggression.gif original GIF], image revision dated 8 July 2018.</ref>
* '''PC Remastered''' ([[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Remastered)]]). The July 2022 image retains the errata wording. It changes the margin mark from E to E1 and drops the uniqueness dot in the margin caption.<ref>Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/angerfearaggression.gif original GIF], image revision dated 31 July 2022.</ref>
